local_wiring: VS Code MCP: mcp.json servers.synapse in the VS Code user data root (auto-generated/merged)
notes: First-party MCP built from mcps/synapse; not an external submodule, so it carries no source_url/path/commit pin.
Zero-config: synapse-bridge reads the bearer token from ~/.synapse/token and autostarts the shared sidecar; no secret is ever written into a host config file.
Project isolation is derived from the bridge process working directory (git root); hosts that launch stdio servers in the open workspace get correct per-project memory automatically.
Generated by default only for first-party secretless MCP services; external or secret-bearing MCPs remain opt-in through --category mcps --service <id>.
Install/update the binary and always-on sidecar service with mcps/synapse/install.sh (npm run install:synapse).

mcp.validation_hint: grimoire-server serves a read-only stdio MCP from ~/.grimoire/index.sqlite; if its tools return INDEX_MISSING/INDEX_STALE the index needs building (npm run install:grimoire). Confirm with the host's MCP status command or by calling grimoire_search.

local_wiring: VS Code MCP: mcp.json servers.grimoire in the VS Code user data root (auto-generated/merged)
notes: First-party read-only MCP built from mcps/grimoire; not an external submodule, so it carries no source_url/path/commit pin.

Serves large Agent-Skill packs just-in-time so the model selects a skill via grimoire_search instead of loading a large catalog at startup; currently serves anthropic-cybersecurity-skills, rev-skills, and hack-skills (see each pack's served_by).
Zero-config and secretless: grimoire-server opens ~/.grimoire/index.sqlite read-only; no secret is ever written into a host config file.
Generated by default only for first-party secretless MCP services; external or secret-bearing MCPs remain opt-in through --category mcps --service <id>.
Build the index and link the binary with mcps/grimoire/install.sh (npm run install:grimoire); a submodule bump or schema change surfaces as INDEX_STALE until rebuilt.
